hero.lead: We invest in founder and family-owned manufacturing, industrial and business-services companies, then help them build the people, processes and systems to grow. No fixed exit clock. No spreadsheet-only thinking.

definition.text: From the Greek phýō: to bring forth, to make grow. The root of every word for living, growing things.

audience.title: One firm, four kinds of partnership.
audience.intro: Tell us where you sit at the table. Here is what working with Phyo looks like from your side.

tabs.label: Founders & families
tabs.title: Plan the next chapter without giving up what you built.
tabs.text: Whether you are planning retirement or handing over to the next generation, we buy into companies to own them for the long run. Your people, customers and community stay at the center of every decision.
points: Long-term ownership, not a quick flip
Stewards of your employees, customers and community

tabs.label: Management teams
tabs.title: Back your growth plan with capital and a partner who has run companies.
tabs.text: We are close enough to know your people and the numbers that drive the business, and far enough back to let you run it. When you need more, we bring it.
points: Strategic plans, financial modeling and analysis
Lender relationships, recruiting and customer introductions

tabs.label: Intermediaries
tabs.title: A buyer that does what it says.
tabs.text: We bring speed, certainty and creativity to lower-middle-market transactions, with efficient diligence and criteria you can screen against in a minute.
points: EBITDA of $3M to $25M, based in the US or Canada
Majority control preferred, select minority stakes considered

tabs.label: Investors
tabs.title: Put capital to work with an active, aligned partner.
tabs.text: Our model suits family offices and private investors who want an operating partner able to deploy capital carefully in the lower-middle market.
points: Capital from our principals, families and private investors
Long-term horizon with no predetermined holding period
Focus on sectors our team has operated in

capabilities.title: Capital is the start. The partnership is the point.
capabilities.intro: Our name means to make grow. Here is how that shows up after the deal closes.

items.title: Flexible long-term capital
items.text: Capital from our principals and a small group of families and private investors, structured to fit the business rather than a fund's timeline.

items.title: Operating experience
items.text: Principals who have run plants, sales teams and P&Ls. We help put the systems, processes and people in place for the next stage of growth.

items.title: Strategic and financial depth
items.text: Support on strategy, financial modeling, add-on acquisitions and lender relationships, so your team can stay focused on running the business.

items.title: A network that opens doors
items.text: Advisors, operating veterans and industry specialists who help with technical problems, customer introductions and hard-to-fill roles.

fit.title: Is your company a fit? Find out in four clicks.
fit.intro: Answer four quick questions. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.

questions.label: Location
questions.question: Is the company based in the US or Canada?

questions.label: Sector
questions.question: Does it operate in manufacturing, industrial products, value-added distribution, logistics or business services?

questions.label: Size
questions.question: Is annual EBITDA (cash flow) between $3M and $25M?

questions.label: Situation
questions.question: Are the owners planning retirement or succession, or is the team looking to grow the business?

empty.title: Your fit score will appear here.
empty.text: Our core criteria: US and Canadian companies in manufacturing, industrial products, value-added distribution, logistics or business services, with EBITDA of $3M to $25M.

strong.title: Strong fit. Let's talk.
strong.text: Your company matches our core criteria. A first conversation is confidential and carries no obligation.

partial.title: Worth a conversation.
partial.text: You match most of our criteria. We also consider select minority investments, and our Heartland Fund covers a wider range of sectors.

low.title: Probably outside our core focus.
low.text: We may not be the right partner today, but owners and intermediaries are always welcome to reach out. If we are not a fit, we will tell you quickly.

fit.note: We prefer majority-control investments and will consider select minority partnerships.

principles.title: Business is a human endeavor, not a spreadsheet exercise.

items.title: Long-term owners
items.text: We want to own companies for a long time. Our structure lets us skip the heavy leverage and short-term decisions that come with short-term capital.

items.title: Trusted stewards
items.text: We care about the employees, communities and customers of every company we back, and we take seriously the trust placed in us for the next chapter of its history.

items.title: People first
items.text: We invest in people, and partner with management teams to take companies as far as they can go.

items.title: Making things here
items.text: Domestic manufacturing makes communities and families stronger. We work to keep and create manufacturing jobs close to home.

items.title: Responsible ownership
items.text: Our responsibility reaches beyond our companies. We build sound governance and community impact into how we invest and how we manage the portfolio.

process.title: From first call to the next chapter.

steps.title: A confidential conversation
steps.text: Tell us about the company, your goals and your timing. Owners, management teams and intermediaries are all welcome.

steps.title: Focused diligence
steps.text: We test fit against our criteria and run efficient diligence. We aim to be clear early and deliver on what we commit to.

steps.title: A structure that fits
steps.text: Capital structured around the business, with no predetermined holding period and no excessive debt.

steps.title: Growing together
steps.text: Your team runs the business. We help build the systems, processes and people for what comes next.

regional.text: A partnership with established families across the region. The fund puts local capital to work in Ohio-based, largely family-owned businesses, preserving their legacies, creating and keeping jobs, and building long-term value for the communities around them.
